title: Presentation where the deck was revised during the talk
purpose: Present quarterly hiring numbers to department heads

brief.text: Hiring plan for the engineering department of a fictional company. Numbers come from the recruiting deck.

sources.title: Recruiting deck
sources.text: Q3: 14 offers accepted of 20 planned hires. Average time to hire 41 days.
